detail:
New decision "Chose add-only union semantics for twining_amend over replace" relates to:
- 01KJDWTR95TCGQR2S0X2G86TT7: "Remove hardcoded PostHog API key, read from POSTHOG_API_KEY env var or config instead"
- 01KQWE989N68PA3ARWEMRGQ5C4: "Added archived to DecisionStatus union rather than moving decision JSON files"
- 01KY0THTBBYC3APWRVREZ3ZSA3: "Chose to file the twining_why size blowup as a v2.1 issue (#41) with a ranked-tier + token-budget design direction over patching a hard result-size cap"
- 01KY11ZFGYPBBRJ4DC8GGXH8S8: "Chose a strict ranked-prefix token budget (once one decision overflows, all lower-ranked ones go compact) over best-fit packing"
- 01KY11ZFPNYARXRTD2CZ0VM76J: "Chose a hardcoded DEFAULT_WHY_MAX_TOKENS=4000 constant mirroring context_assembly.default_max_tokens rather than threading config into DecisionEngine"
- 01KY7WMA73K5R830Z81PPKMWQV: "Chose render-time link derivation (local /api/raw link authoritative + best-effort remote blob link from /api/repo-info) over a URL-rewrite operation on stored entries"
- 01KY7WMABN6SDHBYXG581R0Y75: "Chose a lookbehind boundary guard in the repo-path regex after a test caught '.twining/config.yml' tail-matching as 'twining/config.yml'"
- 01KYB5EM4YC7NFTPACQFSJT3B8: "Chose degrade-to-summary-only for warnings that exceed the token budget, rather than only counting the drops"
- 01KYB5EMERCQGDDCRKRCJ0Z3P5: "Chose to widen why()'s exclusion to a WHY_RETIRED_STATUSES set covering superseded, overridden and archived rather than adding 'overridden' alone"
- 01KZ4YGXPJ5YPDE21X9WGR4QXV: "Chose to keep the structured zod schema's reason_rejected REQUIRED while making the stored type optional"
- 01KZW6QYTVC0RE2YPYG59BK690: "Chose to keep the duplicate Workflow replication running after the four teammate agents turned out alive"
- 01KZW6QYYDG5D63RQR9G10NGT8: "Chose the authoritative sqlite mirror (.twining/records/decisions/) over the legacy v1 directories for all store measurements"
- 01KZWBEFMF7CK3MJ0840YN7Z9H: "Chose to pin total_in_scope semantics with a new regression test rather than only asserting correctness in prose"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 13 existing decision(s) overlap
